summary_paragraph: Mr. ___, a male with relapsed multiple myeloma, chronic hemolytic anemia, type 2 diabetes, and stage 3 chronic kidney disease, was admitted after accidentally taking his home medications twice, including acyclovir, amlodipine, furosemide, and allopurinol. He presented with acute kidney injury, with creatinine rising from a baseline of 2.1 to 3.0, likely due to dehydration and medication overdose. He had no acute symptoms but showed mild mental status changes. His home antihypertensives and diuretics were held initially. Labs improved by discharge with creatinine decreasing to 2.2. He did not require dialysis or transfusion. His multiple myeloma treatment continued unchanged. He was discharged home with all medications resumed, instructions for medication safety using a pill organizer, daily weight monitoring, and follow-up plans.
problems: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic nephropathy
